title: Five equivalent characterisations of a parasitic adequate module
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file adequate.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: For an adequate O-module F on (Sch/S)_tau the lemma gives five equivalent conditions: that vF vanishes, that F is parasitic, that it is parasitic for the tau-topology, that its sections on all open subschemes of S vanish, and that this happens over some affine open covering of S (statement lines 2256-2268). The implications (2) => (3) => (4) => (5) are read off from the definitions, and the substance of the proof is the converse: given an affine open cover with vanishing sections, one takes an arbitrary flat V -> S, covers V by affines each mapping into some U_i, uses flatness of the induced ring maps together with the base change formula for adequate modules to see F(V_j) = 0, and concludes by the Zariski sheaf property; the remaining equivalence (1) <=> (3) is quoted from the chapter's comparison remark (proof lines 2271-2292). The level is H3: the nontrivial implication is proved with an explicit flat-localisation argument, and the one quoted step is a single labelled remark.
